_about: What Mages City intends to publish, in order. The plugin diffs this against the live join manifest.

criteria.description: An invitation this community issued. The City's gate issues one only after VALIDATED (understanding) and a human countersign.

Evidence of work brought for review: the applicant attaches the evidence root (an arena run, a swarm seal, or work done for others) and its chronicle. A human admitter reviews; approval mints membership and a role credential naming the lane.
Everyone else. A human decides; pending grants nothing.
